name: Ironbridge Gorge
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: In Shropshire, England, the River Severn runs through a steep wooded gorge that helped kick-start the Industrial Revolution. Its centrepiece is the Iron Bridge of 1779, the world's first major bridge made of iron, spanning the river between Broseley and Madeley. Nearby at Coalbrookdale, a furnace dating from 1708 recalls the breakthrough of smelting iron with coke.
